breakpoints.note: After the root box header is accepted and `newBox->size` has been derived, GPAC dispatches the parsed `dimC` box into its type-specific reader `dimC_box_read()`.

First project parser statement on the vulnerable path. `gf_isom_box_parse_ex()` reads the root box size from the staged file, and that value later becomes the remaining payload length carried into `dimC_box_read()`.

On the exact witness, step 5 leaves `p->size == 1042`, already larger than `GF_ARRAY_LENGTH(str) == 1024`. The patch fixes this obligation by replacing the fixed stack buffer with `gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * (p->size + 1))`, changing the loop bound to `while (i < msize)`, and rejecting the no-NUL case with `if (i == msize) return GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE;`.
